settings.guarantee_text: If the memory foam core loses its shape under normal domestic use within [guarantee_years] years, we'll replace it. Covers, zips, liners, waterproof layers, bolsters, fibre filling and non-slip bases are wearing parts and aren't included. Nor is damage from chewing, scratching, tearing or accidents, foam damaged by liquid (including urine) or by washing, softening that recovers when the bed is empty, or commercial use.

settings.question: How do I know which size to get?
settings.answer: Measure nose to base of tail while they're lying down, then add about 20cm. Between two sizes? Size up. Each size on this page shows its own measurements, and the size guide is built from them. Still unsure? Send us a photo of them asleep and we'll tell you.

settings.question: Is it too soft or too firm for an older dog?
settings.answer: Where we know a bed's feel, it's on that bed's spec card, from 1 (soft) to 5 (firm). Older, stiffer dogs usually do best on medium to firm: soft enough to take the pressure off, firm enough to push up from. If you get it wrong, the [trial_nights]-night trial covers it.

settings.question: How thick is the foam in each size?
settings.answer: Where the maker gives us the measurement, it's on the bed's spec card under Foam depth. If it isn't there yet, message us before you order and we'll tell you what we know. "Orthopaedic" on its own tells you nothing; the depth and what the foam is made of do.

settings.question: What's inside the beds?
settings.answer: It depends on the bed, so each page says what's inside that one: memory foam, egg-crate foam, crumb memory foam, fibre or mesh. The spec card lists what we know about the core and cover, and leaves out anything we can't confirm.

settings.question: Can I actually wash it?
settings.answer: On most of the range the cover comes off to wash, following the care label sewn into it. Beds with a coated, waterproof cover are wiped clean instead, because detergent strips the coating. Each bed's page says which applies, and whether it has a waterproof liner.

settings.question: Can I buy a spare cover?
settings.answer: Not yet. Message us and we'll tell you when they're in.

settings.question: Is it chew-proof?
settings.answer: No dog bed is, and we won't pretend otherwise. If your dog chews or digs at beds, message us before you order and we'll tell you which bed stands the best chance.

settings.question: When will it arrive?
settings.answer: You'll see this bed's delivery dates above the button before you order. Most beds are dispatched within 1 to 2 working days, then standard delivery takes [delivery_min] to [delivery_max] working days, free on orders over [threshold]. Some beds ship from our partner warehouse or are made to order and take longer. Tracking comes by email as soon as it's on its way.

settings.question: What if my dog just won't use it?
settings.answer: Then it comes back. Let your dog sleep on it for up to [trial_nights] nights. [trial_terms] Just tell us inside that window. It doesn't need to be unused: send it back slept on, hair and all. One trial per household. Full terms are in our [returns_policy].

settings.question: Will it help a dog with arthritis or stiff hips?
settings.answer: A supportive bed spreads their weight so pressure isn't concentrated on hips, elbows and shoulders. But a bed is not a treatment and it won't replace veterinary care, so please keep talking to your vet. What it can change is the surface they spend so many hours a day on.
